name: All Mail Buddy for Proton
summary: For Proton Mail Bridge: shows the real folder and labels of every message in All Mail and makes delete, move, archive and junk act on the message in its real folder.
description:
Proton Mail Bridge shows every message in the All Mail folder, but there you cannot see where a message really lives, and deleting or moving it does not do what you expect. All Mail Buddy fixes that. Features
  • Real folder at a glance: the columns Folder and Labels in the table view, a badge on each card in the cards view.
  • Actions on the real message: Delete, Shift+Delete, Move, Copy, Archive, Junk, Not junk, drag and drop and the row buttons act on the message in its real folder, not on the All Mail view of it.
  • Safe by design: a message is only acted on when exactly one real copy matches. Before deleting for good, the add-on checks on the server that the copy is still the right message.
  • Messages without a folder: finds messages that exist only in All Mail and lets you file, archive or delete them, also all at once through a saved search.
  • Stays in sync: a light check every few minutes notices changes made in other Proton apps and syncs only the folders that changed.
  • Diagnosis: the settings page explains each problem in plain words and offers a repair of exactly the affected folders.
Every other folder and account keeps Thunderbird's normal behavior. The add-on talks only to your local Bridge, through Thunderbird's own IMAP connection. Requires Thunderbird 153 or later and Proton Mail Bridge. Not affiliated with Proton AG.
